title: Tolan's small boat fleet welcomes a stronger season

facts.subject: Tolan's fishing cooperatives
facts.statement: Tolan's fishing cooperatives report a better season for inshore boats, with steady catches and firm prices at the harbour market.

source_ref.text_snippet: Tolan's fishing cooperatives report a better season for inshore boats, with steady catches and firm prices at the harbour market.

facts.subject: harbour market prices
facts.statement: Prices at the harbour market have held up because buyers from the hotels and the processing plant have been active.

source_ref.text_snippet: Prices at the harbour market have held up because buyers from the hotels and the processing plant have been active.

facts.subject: cold storage facility
facts.statement: The cooperative says the cold store was built for a smaller fleet and a shorter season.

source_ref.text_snippet: The cooperative says the cold store was built for a smaller fleet and a shorter season.

facts.subject: tourism at the harbour
facts.statement: Tourism operators say the harbour is busier than last summer.
